text:
sanjay: FYI I pushed the preliminary postmortem notes from last night's cascade into the doc. main root cause looks like auth token renewal failures from the model-registry provider.

ops-bot: INCIDENT #2026-451 created by sanjay — vendor auth outage -> degraded model pulls. Priority: P1.

elaine: Thanks. Can we list actionable remediation items & owners here? want a clear timeline for the next 2 weeks.

ken: I'll take ownership of short-term mitigation: automatic retry + jitter for registry pulls, and add a lightweight local cache fallback. Target: 3 business days.

ash: I'll own the rollout to Dedicated clusters (config + canary). ETA 1 week.

maria: I'll add alerts and an eval to detect silent token renewals (canary prompt failures) and write the test harness. ETA 5 days.

tim: I'll coordinate vendor communication — need a formal postmortem from ACME SRE and SLA re-eval. Can we have a vendor call by end of week? @acme-sre can you confirm availability?

acme-sre: We're available Fri 1400 UTC. We have initial logs and suspect their auth signer service experienced a heighted retry storm. We'll bring root cause detail.

sanjay: Good. Specific action list copied from the doc: 
- A1: Implement retry + exponential backoff for registry token refreshes (owner: ken) — DUE: +3d
- A2: Local model-cache fallback w/ eviction for up to 2m (owner: ken) — DUE: +3d
- A3: Canary synthetic that validates token refresh flow + model pull every 5m (owner: maria) — DUE: +5d
- A4: Dedicated cluster rollout plan + rollback playbook (owner: ash) — DUE: +7d
- A5: Vendor SLA review + formal RCA call (owner: tim) — DUE: Fri EOD
- A6: Add circuit-breaker at routing layer to avoid cascade (owner: elaine) — DUE: +10d
- A7: Add postmortem action tracker entry and weekly recurrence check (owner: sanjay) — DUE: +1d

elaine: Adding low-risk mitigation now: set short-term token TTL acceptance window to avoid sharp expiry spikes (config patch). Rolling it in infra at 10m maintenance window.

ken: Quick note: local-cache will be opt-in via env var for now. implementation: 
```
# pseudo
fetch_model(){
  try { pull_from_registry() }
  catch(e){
    if (cache_has(model)) return cache_get(model)
    throw e
  }
}
```
I'll open PRs for retry lib + cache today.

maria: For the synthetic: I'll add a small harness that does token renew -> pull -> verify logits. If it fails 3x in a row send pager to eng-oncall. Outline in PR.

tim: Vendor asked for our spike logs; I dropped S3 link in the doc. acme-sre said they'll ingest and provide timestamps.

acme-sre: We will share correlation of our signer latencies with your registry requests by EOD Thu. Also prepping an action item list on our side.

ash: For dedicated rollout: plan is canary 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on 5xxs or latency > 2x baseline. I'll add the rollout YAML to the PR.

sanjay: Can we agree on checkpoints? quick sync Thu morning for status, Fri vendor call after their logs, and a final review next Tue.

elaine: agreed. I'll own the Thursday checkpoint invite.

ken: PRs opened: retry-lib #4123, cache-proxy #4124. Requesting reviews from @ash @maria.

maria: Reviewing now. I ran local harness against sim-failure and saw expected fallback. minor comments left.

tim: For SLA discussion, please include usage patterns (burst windows) and any rate-limits that matter. I added a short summary in the doc.

ops-bot: Reminder — add postmortem tags: vendor:acme, category:auth, severity:degraded-service.

sanjay: Closing loop: I'll track these in the weekly mitigation tracker and update owners if anything slips. If anyone needs to reassign, ping me. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

elaine: quick follow-up: can we add a recurring audit (monthly) to catch pattern regressions? I'll add as a follow-up task (owner: elaine).

acme-sre: Thanks team, we'll see you Fri.

ken: marking A1/A2 in the PR descriptions with the due dates.

maria: added synthetic to ops dashboard. will surface regression alerts to eng-oncall.

sanjay: done for now — will post updated action tracker tomorrow morning.
